name: 共鸣符文
prompt: Create one production game VFX texture and inventory icon: a single narrow vertical rune inscription strip, centered on a genuinely transparent alpha background, canvas portrait 1024x1536. Silver-white luminous fine engraved glyph strokes only, with bright white cores and restrained silver glow, absolutely no colored tint. Isolated flat 2D orthographic design, no sword, no metal surface, no frame, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no checkerboard. The pattern occupies central 45 percent width and 85 percent height, leaving clean empty margins. Intricate elegant fantasy runic inscription, visibly readable individual glyphs, transparent holes. This will be projected along a blue crystal sword blade and flickered by a shader. RESONANCE: a balanced chain of three circular harmonic seals, fine concentric broken rings, small diamond nodes and four-point silver stars joined by a slender straight axis; rhythmic symmetric arcs, clean graceful magical geometry.
